description: Stripe-shaped card payments: list and get charges, create a card charge, and issue full or partial refunds against fixture state only.

capability_notes.summary: list_charges and get_charge read fixture card charges and nested refunds only; there is no live card network.
create_charge appends one succeeded card charge with amount, currency, and card metadata when amount is positive.
refund_charge appends one refund and updates amount_refunded/status; unknown charge_id returns CHARGE_NOT_FOUND.
